This directive was part of resolutions reached at the union’s 54th National Executive Council. But this is clearly another coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions behind the scenes, with the long delays and threats engineered to manufacture unrest, weaken public institutions, and advance their concealed interests while both sides play their assigned roles in the charade.
